title: Molly Jam (2013)
description: Rescue the red headed princess from the big bad trolls while looking awesome! This game was based off a few quotes from Peter Molyneux. The quotes I choose where: "If you go into battle, you could win a ginger-haired person" "What do the taps mean ?" "Pull the right trigger to see the most interesting thing in the world" "Golden acorn" "Collect a million gold coins"
descriptionHtml:
Rescue the red headed princess from the big bad trolls while looking awesome! This game was based off a few quotes from Peter Molyneux. The quotes I choose where:

  • "What do the taps mean ?"
  • "Pull the right trigger to see the most interesting thing in the world"
  • "Golden acorn"
  • "Collect a million gold coins"
